mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses equity discount rates and signals monetary easing, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and economic support.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that dampens corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as markets price in tighter financial conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and rises in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate weakening consumer demand and labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with HOUST decline and UNRATE rise, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions with GDP growth above 2.0% annualized, S&P 500 underperforms due to stretched valuations and policy tightening risks, producing negative 60-day forward returns as economic momentum peaks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate trend over the past 6 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with rising UNRATE, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS) falls below 50,000 jobs for two consecutive months, it indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances with PAYEMS < 50000 for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and rises in inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicate stagflationary supply shocks that contract corporate margins and delay monetary easing, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with INDPRO decline and CPIAUCSL rise, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In supply contraction regimes marked by industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for three consecutive months, S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 days due to reduced corporate output and persistent inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO < 100 for three months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
